newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla fed cattle trade at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area Friday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reporting light inquiry from buyers following weekly movement of 113,500.
The last established price was $61.00-$62.00 per cwt on
Thursday. Friday's packer bids were $62.00, with asking prices
